profile.name: St. Jaygarcia Saturn

reasons.reason: Há traits ligados ao uso ou à evolução da Skill 2; seu acesso recebe prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When using Skill 2 to attack an enemy with a lowered max HP who is capturing Treasure: Nullifies an enemy's Traits and KOs them instead of dealing damage (excludes invincibility).
When using Skill 2: Class changes to Defender(s).

reasons.reason: Capturar tesouro ativa traits. O perfil considera esse benefício além da classe.

evidence.text: When you capture the Treasure: Class changes to Defender(s). and Boosts Power Gauge by 1.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: Power Gauge can be used (increases up to 5, but resets once KO'd). and Trait KO Possible icon will appear on an enemy with a lowered max HP who is capturing Treasure.
When Power Gauge is at 1 or higher: Recover 100% of HP when enough damage is taken to KO character. and Nullify status effects inflicted by enemy.
When the Trait "Recover HP when enough damage is taken to KO character" activates: Uses 1 unit(s) of the Power Gauge. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 50%.
When you start capturing the enemy's Treasure: Class changes to Runner(s).
Recovers the Treasure Gauge 50% past its maximum amount. and Can ignore the enemy and refill the Treasure Gauge.
When the Treasure Gauge is recovered to 150%: Boosts Power Gauge by 1. and SPD: Boosted by 20% for 20 second(s). (Cannot Stack)
While you are capturing Treasure: Resist Stagger, being Downed, and Knockback. and Boost capture speed by 50%.
When attacking an enemy, 100% chance to: Increase DEF by 5% (increases up to 50% but resets once KO'd). and Reduces enemy's max HP by 30% of damage dealt.
When in the Treasure Area: Resist Stagger and Knockback.
When dealing damage on the 3rd hit of a normal attack combo: Knock enemies back.
When an enemy begins capturing one of your team's Treasure Areas: Recover HP by 20%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 30%.
Increase Treasure Gauge recovery amount by 50%. and Reduce the damage received from enemy skills by 50%.
When attacked by an enemy who has obtained a defensive shield: DEF: Boosted by 50% for 3 second(s). (Cannot Stack) and Remove enemy's ATK increase. (Including after the defensive shield is destroyed)

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Defender presume defesa do próprio tesouro sem aliados próximos. Captura, tesouro inimigo e aliados próximos ficam desativados; outras condições usam 0,5 e eventos 0,25.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
